message.content: Review feedback on the Terraform PR: (1) tag every resource with `team = platform`, (2) don't hard-code the region in main.tf, (3) add descriptions to all variables. Address them.

content.text: Done: added `team = platform` to the tags of all 9 resources; main.tf now uses var.region instead of the literal; added descriptions to all 6 variables in variables.tf. terraform validate: success.

message.content: The security reviewer says the database security group allows 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0. Restrict it to the VPC CIDR.

content.text: Done: the 5432 ingress rule now uses var.vpc_cidr instead of 0.0.0.0/0. terraform validate: success; terraform plan shows 1 resource to change (the security group) and nothing else.
